physicalNotes: Radius 0.516 +/- 0.016 solar radii from Lamontagne et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of GJ 3090 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...706A.278L/abstract): 358,981 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
